ReapletonLink.author: hemisphera
ReapletonLink.about: Headless REAPER extension that bridges REAPER's tempo, transport and timeline position into an Ableton Link session (REAPER is the master).

Hulp.author: hemisphera
Hulp.about: Hulp is a live-performance helper for the REAPER DAW. It turns a REAPER project into a set of songs, drives a record-then-loop workflow during playback, and streams the session state over OSC to a browser dashboard that you can keep on a second screen or a phone.
